[[File:BalatroHands.png|thumb|400px|List of poker hands that can be found by clicking "Run Info"]]
'''Poker Hands''' are sets of one to five cards that can be played in ''[[Balatro]]'' to obtain {{Chips|}} and [[Mult]] for scoring. Each hand also has a level that affects its potency. In general, the more difficult it is to play a certain Poker Hand, the higher its base score will be. For example, a {{Ph|Pair}} will score for much less than a {{Ph|Four of a Kind}}.

At the beginning of a run, all Hands start at Level 1, and are generally upgraded through [[Planet Cards|{{hl|cyan|Planet cards}}]]. Hands can also be upgraded with the{{Tag|Orbital}}, the {{Spectral|Black Hole}} [[Spectral Cards|{{hl|sblue|Spectral card}}]], {{J|Burnt Joker}}, and {{J|Space Joker}}. The level can also be permanently decreased by {{Blind|The Arm}}. There is no limit to how many times a Poker Hand can be leveled up. Furthermore, the Poker Hand levels are reset back to Level 1 each time when starting a new run.

Higher-tier hands take precedence over lower-tier hands regardless of their level or scoring. For example, if the hand is 9 9 9 9 2, and all of them are diamonds, the hand will always be a Four of a Kind and never a Flush. By selecting the desired cards before playing them, it is possible to check which Poker Hand it will count as on the left-hand side, over the scoreboard. An exception to this is when playing against a [[Blinds and Antes|Boss Blind]] that turns cards in hand face down which, when selected, will make the poker hand name appear as "???" until it is played.

Generally, only the cards relevant to the hand are scored. All others are not scored. For example, if an Ace is played as a {{Ph|High Card}} with 4 other cards, only the High Card base amount and the Ace's values are used for the hand's score. The other cards (up to 4) are just discarded and have no effect. However, sometimes it can be beneficial to play extra cards as an extra discard while still having the main hand score. This would not work with any hand that requires five cards to be played. The main exceptions to this rule are with {{J|Splash}}, which explicitly allows all played cards to be scored, with {{j|Four Fingers}}, which can be used to score a {{Ph|Straight}} that contains two cards of matching rank (A A K Q J); and with {{Enhancement|Stone}} to gain an extra {{Chips|+50}}.

== Secret Poker Hands ==
There are three "secret" Poker Hands that are only possible through adding more playing cards to the deck, or changing existing cards with Consumables or Jokers. These Poker Hands will not appear in the Run Info screen until they have been played at least once, after which they will show up on the info menu, and their respective Planet Cards will be obtainable '''only during the current run'''. These Poker Hands will also be upgraded by {{Spectral|Black Hole}}, even before they are unlocked.

==Additional Notes==
*The exact judgment criteria of a {{ph|Straight Flush}} is "any hand which is both a Straight and a Flush". With {{J|Four Fingers}}, it's possible to make a Straight Flush with such cards as 9♠️ 8♠️ 7♥️ 6♠️ 3♠️. Additionally, a Royal Flush is "a Straight Flush with all cards of rank 10 or higher".
**Similarly, the exact judgment criteria of a '''Flush House''' is "any hand which is both a Full House and a Flush". With {{J|Four Fingers}}, it's possible to make a Flush House with such cards as 8♠️ 8♠️ 8♥️ 6♠️ 6♠️.
**In much the same way, the exact judgement criteria of '''Flush Five''' is "any hand which is both Five of a Kind and a Flush". With {{J|Four Fingers}}, it's possible to make a Flush Five with 5 cards of the same rank, of which only 4 are of the same suit.
*{{Ph|Two Pair}} and {{Ph|Full House}} require that the cards are of different ranks. Thus, {{ph|Four of a Kind}}, {{ph|Five of a Kind}}, and {{ph|Flush Five}} are not considered as containing '''Two Pair''', and '''Five of a Kind''' and '''Flush Five''' do not contain a '''Full House'''.
*A poker hand's type is unaffected by the card order. For example, a {{ph|Straight}} will still count as one, even if the cards are played as 10, Ace, Queen, King, Jack. This makes it useful with Jokers like {{J|Hanging Chad}}, so certain cards in the scoring order can maximize their potential.
*In older versions, it was possible for poker hands to be decreased to Level 0, by playing a hand of Level 1 during {{Blind|The Arm}}. This was changed to a minimum of level 1 in [[Update 1.0.0k|1.0.0k]].
*Unlike most Poker Hands that level up through the use of a Planet Card, the {{ph|Royal Flush}} instead levels up alongside the {{ph|Straight Flush}}.

==Trivia==
* X(''number'') of a kind are sometimes referred as Xoak (for example, 3oak/4oak) for short in the community.
* In poker terminology, the two types of straight that Ace can form are called ''Broadway Straight'' (A K Q J 10) and ''Wheel Straight'' (A 2 3 4 5). These names are sometimes used in the community.
* Each secret poker hand is impossible to encounter when using a standard 52-card deck with 13 cards in each suit.
* {{ph|Flush Five}} used to not exist and was considered as {{ph|Five of a Kind}}. The Flush Five (with the corresponding [[Planet Cards|planet card]] {{Planet|Eris}}) was later introduced in January 2024.<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/1116389027176787968/1201980596533084160/1201980600723189920 Announcement of update in Balatro Discord]</ref>
